description: The exact balance a wallet held at a past time or checkpoint, read from full history. With coin, that coin's balance and the transaction that last changed it. Without coin, every coin it held then, valued at that time's prices. Example: { address: "example.sui", coin: "SUI", time: "2025-06-01T00:00:00Z" }.

address.description: A Sui address (0x...), a SuiNS name like example.sui, or @example.

checkpoint.description: A checkpoint sequence number, instead of time.

coin.description: Coin type or symbol. Leave it out for all coins.

time.description: A past time: ISO 8601 like 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z (UTC), or unix seconds.

name: balance_at
title: Balance at a past time
